description.text: A high-class pack released on 20 October 2017 that reprinted strong cards of the Sun & Moon series, all in holo, with one Pokémon-GX in every pack. It added three new Ultra Beast Pokémon-GX, Pheromosa-GX, Xurkitree-GX and Celesteela-GX, and some reprints have new illustrations. Packs held seven holo cards, and each box of ten packs held one card of Super Rare or higher. The cards are numbered to 114, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon-GX, Lana, Lillie and Lusamine, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon-GX, and gold Ultra Rare Lunala-GX and Solgaleo-GX. Its Super Rare Lillie became famous under the nickname Ganbalillie.
